name: LocationPermitManager
tagline: Every filming location cleared on time – recces, permits, neighbour notices and clearances in one app.
description: A complete location-department app for film, TV and commercial productions. Track locations from scout to wrap on a rule-checked board, apply for permits within each film office's lead time, record grants with reference and validity, send neighbour notices, tick insurance, risk assessment and agreements, and catch double bookings, crew caps and hours outside the permit – in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Pipeline Scouted → Recce → Approved → Applied → Granted → Wrapped with checklist per status
Authority lead days and Apply now / No permit alerts
Permit reference and validity check against the last shoot day
Generated neighbour notice with radius and signature (NoticeJson)
Clearances: insurance, risk assessment, location agreement
Double-booking, crew cap, permitted hours (overnight aware) and budget checks
Two-week calendar with recce, notice and expiry markers
Bulk status, bulk notices, CSV export, undo
Phone layout with status chips and bottom view bar
